description: This file provides a utility function 'safeWriteJson' for safely writing JSON data to a file with directory creation, file locking, backup, and rollback mechanisms. It uses streaming to handle large JSON objects efficiently.

methods.name: safeWriteJson
methods.description: Asynchronously writes JSON data to a specified file path, ensuring directory existence, file locking, backup of existing files, and rollback on errors.

methods.name: _streamDataToFile
methods.description: Streams JSON data to a file using a JSON disassembler and stringer, handling errors during streaming.
